_comment: Settings for WinCheckup. Remove a line to use the default. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_comment_people: Empty InspectorName = asked at the start (the last name used is offered).
_comment_output: Empty ReportFolder = a Reports folder next to the script (or Documents when that is read-only). %USERPROFILE% style variables work.
_comment_thresholds: Battery health is % of the original design capacity; SSD wear is % of rated life used.
_comment_tests: A FAIL in a critical test makes the device NOT FUNCTIONAL. SkipTests leaves physical tests out, e.g. ["Fingerprint reader", "Other ports"].
